description: Endogenous gammaretrovirus lineage found in killer whales and other toothed whales (Odontoceti).

notes: Related to the retrovirus lineage that includes feline RD114.

description: Feline endogenous gammaretrovirus lineage that gave rise to the prototype RD114 virus.

description: Porcine endogenous gammaretrovirus lineage restricted to pigs and closely related suids.
notes: Although PERV-C infects only pig cells, recombination with PERV-A can generate PERV-A/C viruses capable of infecting human cells in vitro, making it a major focus of xenotransplantation safety research.

description: Rhinoceros rhoretrovirus lineage identified from endogenous retroviral sequences.
notes: One of the few known rhoretrovirus-related lineages in large mammals.

description: Horse endogenous retrovirus lineage belonging to the 'rho' subgroup of clade I retroviruses.
Canid member of the widespread ERV-Fc radiation that remained active until relatively recent evolutionary times.
notes: Descends from a recombinant ERV-Fc lineage and includes insertions that remain polymorphic in modern dogs and wolves.

notes: Historically one of the most important endogenous retrovirus systems, helping reveal how infectious retroviruses can evolve into highly successful intracellular genomic parasites.

description: Betaretrovirus-like endogenous retroviral sequence originally identified during searches for novel human retroviruses.
notes: Originally reported as "Human Retrovirus 5" (HRV-5), a putative human retrovirus associated with autoimmune disease, before being shown to derive from rabbit-associated sequences.

description: Highly amplified betaretrovirus-like lineage found in South American rodents.
notes: Expanded to unprecedented copy numbers (~10,000 copies) making it one of the most successful endogenous retrovirus lineages known.

description: Endogenous betaretrovirus lineage identified in pythons.

description: Ancient deltaretrovirus lineage identified in long-fingered bats (Miniopteridae).
notes: The first endogenous deltaretrovirus discovered.

description: Ancient deltaretrovirus lineage identified in Mollosus bats.
notes: Demonstrates deltaretroviruses have entered bat germlines on multiple independent occasions.

description: Endogenous deltaretrovirus lineage identified in tube-nosed bats, preserving evidence of an ancient bat-associated deltaretrovirus lineage.
notes: Expands the known diversity of endogenous deltaretroviruses.

description: Deltaretrovirus-derived ERV identified in the river dolphin (Platanista) genome.
notes: Provides evidence for a broader historical distribution of deltaretroviruses.

description: Ancient endogenous lentivirus lineage identified in colugos (Dermoptera).
